Huge payload capacity: With up to 463 lbs of total carrying capacity and a 220-lb rear rack rating, this bike means business. It’s as practical as it is powerful.

I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again: few bike styles benefit more from a motor than a cargo bike, and the GSD proves that point perfectly. With Bosch’s 85Nm Cargo Line motor on board, this thing makes hill climbing feel surprisingly manageable, even when loaded down.

notes: Page is GSD Gen 3; EBReport review says 'Now in its third generation', so same generation. Maker page gives no e-bike class (EBReport: Class 1, no throttle). Maker spec table lists 'MAX LOAD WEIGHT: 210 kg (463 lb)' identical to 'MAX GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT', so 463 lb is a total (bike+rider+cargo) -> basis total; max rider weight is 130 kg (286.6 lb). Maker contradicts itself on rider height: highlights say 150-200 cm (4'11"-6'7"), spec table says 'SUGGESTED RIDER HEIGHT: 153 - 200 cm (60.2 - 78.7 in)'. No rated motor watts on maker or review page. Fold recorded 'No' as a judgment call (handlebar-only fold) — reviewer may want to confirm. Only one independent source: electricbikereview.com search returned no results for 'Tern GSD S10'; REI search lists only the GSD P10 Gen 3, not the S10.
